request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, Which Formly type can I use for a Boolean checkbox, and what does the boolean alias extend?
usable_if: Name boolean extends checkbox, FormlyMatCheckboxModule and form-field wrapper.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, When does a checkbox show an indeterminate state? Does false qualify, or must the control value be nullish?
usable_if: Require enabled props.indeterminate and null/undefined; false alone does not qualify; no three-state cycling promise.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, How can I hide the checkbox required asterisk without treating that as disabling required validation?
usable_if: hideRequiredMarker true hides marker; separate presentation from validation.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, Why can a checkbox display its own label even when the wrapper label is hidden by default?
usable_if: Own props.label, default hideLabel true; no lost label claim.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, What payload does a multicheckbox use by default, and when I uncheck an option is its key removed or set to false?
usable_if: Map keyed by option values; writes false, preserves other entries, no initialization promise.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, How do I make a multicheckbox return selected values as an array instead of a Boolean map?
usable_if: props.type array distinct from field type multicheckbox; no migration promise.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, For a multicheckbox with props.type set to array, how are options checked and removed if option values are objects? Does select compareWith apply?
usable_if: indexOf/strict identity, filter on uncheck; no inherited select compareWith or structural equality.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, How are individual multicheckbox options disabled, and does disabling one automatically remove its saved value?
usable_if: option.disabled or formControl.disabled; no automatic removal guarantee.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, Which toggle properties are forwarded for label position, color and required state, and who renders its label?
usable_if: labelPosition/color/required bindings, own label, wrapper hideLabel true; not every raw Material prop.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, Can I treat the toggle renderer as proof that every MatSlideToggle property is exposed and that a required marker enforces affirmative consent?
usable_if: Reject universal forwarding and unsupported affirmative-consent claim; explain bounded renderer support.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, how do I hide a field without losing its model value?
usable_if: Explain resetOnHide false and scope; do not promise control remains registered.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, what are the datepicker minimum and maximum date property paths?
In Formly 6.3.12 Material, does converting JSON Schema also register all the renderers?
usable_if: No; conversion and registration separate; no turnkey Material registration recipe.

request: In Formly 7 Material, how does multicheckbox store selected values?
usable_if: Stop unsupported version; no substitution to 6.3.12.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Bootstrap, is the Material toggle label behavior guaranteed?
usable_if: Do not deliver Material behavior as Bootstrap guarantee; acknowledge scope gap.
